problem_type: Duplicate bundled GLB URL owners bypass the established render-only asset boundary
symptom: bundleAssetUrlBoundary finds six URL declaration modules instead of the unchanged four allowed modules.
direct_cause: Scene3D redeclares the Nomi model/animation URLs and ueSpike declares the separate UE4 URL instead of reusing the existing mannequin asset owner.
class_root: Bundled mannequin asset addresses must have one render-only source owner while existing consumers retain their distinct model/animation identities.
affected_population: Scene3D Nomi model and locomotion rendering
internal_only_reason: This is module ownership of already-bundled repository assets. No GLB bytes, rig/library behavior, binary license or third-party API is changed or assumed.
invariants: The four-path URL whitelist and detector are unchanged
Every existing asset basename and public export remains unchanged
Nomi model, locomotion animation and UE4 model remain distinct; no asset is substituted
Only the established render-only mannequinAssets module constructs these URLs; no URL enters project persistence

door_reduction.why_not: These are legitimate render-only loaders and existing public re-export consumers. Keep their APIs and make them share address construction rather than removing rig/rendering functionality.

generality_proof: The original whole-src boundary test remains unchanged. New real-import tests assert old consumer values equal the canonical owner, exact pre-fix resolved asset paths remain the same and UE4/animation are not substituted with the Nomi model.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Canonical render-only mannequin asset address owner

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Re-export the canonical owner values while preserving names and exact URLs
Re-export its distinct pre-existing UE4 model address from the same owner without touching rig math

recurrence.reason: A second module declaring bundle-relative URLs can create divergent model identity or values that later cross persistence boundaries.
same_class_scan: Original bundle URL guard enumerates all src TS/TSX declarations
Generated actual symbol door map and inspected all three declaration modules
Read Nomi/animation/UE4 distinct names and their existing consumers

prevention.invariant: One established render-only module constructs bundled mannequin URLs.
prevention.failure_mode: The unchanged boundary guard rejects any newly introduced URL owner and real-import regression rejects model substitution or stale compatibility exports.
prevention.strategy: Move only URL construction into the existing owner and remove old declarations in the same change.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove duplicate URL constructors, retain compatibility exports only.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No library/API/binary change; this is existing asset ownership.

migration: No project migration, GLB replacement or media commit; public exports and exact resolved paths remain compatible.
residual_risks: No actual Three loader/render or App screenshot is run in this bounded task; only URL/module behavior is verified

The unchanged door-map tool reports consumer references, not URL definitions or pure re-exports: the real-diff check retains three door-coverage advisories for the three changed asset declaration/export modules. Generated doors are preserved; no manual fake entries, scope omissions, checker changes or exemptions are used.
